Fixture Property

This site exists so the engine can demonstrate a complete action lifecycle on infrastructure we actually control: a detector finds a real gap here, the engine generates the fix, the fix is applied, and the next run's verification pass observes the result. Findings on domains we cannot deploy to stay at proposed instead.

It ships without a robots.txt or an XML sitemap on purpose — the same condition found on a real portfolio domain during research — so the first run has something true to detect.
